summary: The filing reports that Trinseo PLC and certain subsidiaries entered Chapter 11 bankruptcy on May 28, 2026, to implement a prepackaged restructuring support agreement announced May 13, 2026. They secured $142.5M in new DIP facilities and amended a $150M receivables securitization to fund operations. A joint plan of reorganization is backed by senior lenders; court filings are available via Kroll and a restructuring website. Watch: court approval of the plan, potential creditor recoveries, and exit financing terms.
